question: How is the mark portion divided to determine the space portion and bud rise?
premises: The mark portion is to be divided.
The division is into eight parts.
One space portion is taken for the bud rise.
inference: Having divided the mark portion into eight, one space portion is assigned to the rise of the bud.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of mukulodayam to vyomāṃśaṃ is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: Having divided the mark portion into eight, take one space portion for the rise of the bud.
